name: flux
description: Flux — self-hosted media library platform with torrent acquisition, TMDb requests, and HLS streaming.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @flux/shared && npm run build --workspace @flux/backend && npm run build --workspace @flux/frontend
scripts.roku:check: bsc --project apps/roku/bsconfig.json --create-package false --copy-to-staging false && node apps/roku/scripts/validate.mjs
